name: settings-profile
title: Profile settings
description: Personal profile defaults to mode='editable': avatar header, name and email, locale and time zone, with a sticky save bar. Opt into mode='read-only' for an initials avatar without upload or Edit actions, identity and optional context description lists, and optional ordered roles badges. identity/context accept { id, label, value, mono } rows; value may be a link. contextFallback supplies missing-value text; emptyRolesMessage supplies the empty roles state. Omitted roles/context hide their sections. Read-only mode passes saveBar='none' through SettingsFrame and has no profile form controls, copy buttons or save actions; the responsive section navigation remains available.
author: gntik-ai
